selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: How did the people answer when Allah showed them His mercy and kindness through good gifts?
questions.answer: They answered with thankfulness and praise.

questions.question: Who were they thanking?
questions.answer: They were thanking Allah, the true Giver.

questions.question: What do the many blessings in the whole world do?
questions.answer: They show praise and thanks to Allah.

questions.question: Where are these blessings described as being spread out?
questions.answer: They are spread through the universe and across the earth.

questions.question: What in the passage shows Allah’s generosity?
questions.answer: The many gifts and mercy He gives show His generosity.

questions.question: What kind of things are said to offer thanks by the way they are made?
questions.answer: The beautiful, orderly fruits of mercy and blessing do.

questions.question: How do those fruits give this message?
questions.answer: Their neat and balanced design shows it.

questions.question: What big idea does this passage teach about blessings?
questions.answer: Blessings should lead people to thank and praise Allah.

questions.question: What did the people do after seeing mercy and compassion in the blessings?
questions.answer: They gave thanks and praise.

questions.question: Why do they say no one can thank Allah enough?
questions.answer: Because Allah deserves more thanks than people can fully give.

questions.question: What does the passage say all blessings are doing?
questions.answer: They are praising and thanking Allah.

questions.question: How are blessings on the earth pictured?
questions.answer: They are shown like many gifts set out for everyone to see.

questions.question: What do the gifts in the world tell us about Allah?
questions.answer: They tell us He is generous and gives freely.

questions.question: What are people meant to notice when they look at these gifts?
questions.answer: They should notice Allah’s mercy, kindness, and care.

questions.question: Are only words used for thanks in this passage, or are created things also part of it?
questions.answer: Created things are also part of it.

questions.question: What should a believer learn from this passage?
questions.answer: A believer should see Allah’s gifts and be grateful to Him.

questions.question: Which feeling comes first in this passage when people see Allah’s gifts?
questions.answer: Thankfulness comes first.

questions.question: What other feeling is joined with thankfulness?
questions.answer: Praise is joined with it.

questions.question: What does the passage say about Allah and praise?
questions.answer: It says all praise belongs to Him.

questions.question: What fills the universe in this part of the passage?
questions.answer: Allah’s blessings fill it.

questions.question: What do the blessings across the earth seem to announce?
questions.answer: They seem to announce praise for Allah.

questions.question: What does the passage use as an example of mercy and blessing that gives thanks?
questions.answer: It uses well-made fruits of mercy and blessing.

questions.question: Why do those fruits help people think of Allah?
questions.answer: Because their beauty and order show His giving and care.

questions.question: If a child enjoys food, plants, and other good things, what is a right response from this passage?
questions.answer: To thank Allah and praise Him.

title: Reality of Prayer Responding to the Creator's Acts with Knowledge Love and Gratitude
